The numerator has the fuel density and squared fuel velocity, the parenthesis contains a plus sign and the factor 2 multiplying ell C, and the denominator has the oxidizer density, squared oxidizer velocity, S and ell. The page explicitly introduces this as a liquid/liquid correlation for oxidizer injected through slots in the pintle, adapted from reference 10, with Figure 4 showing inner slots and outer annulus. It defines A as fuel-slot/annulus width, S as oxidizer-slot width, ell as oxidizer-slot length, and C as a cross-influence term defined in reference 10; all four lengths are printed in inches. The subsequent note reports the same expression also found applicable to gas/liquid designs according to reference 38. This review does not recover C's definition from reference 10 or establish a computable universal design correlation.
